typesense:popular.greeting:
*Your boyfriend, Nicholas, was never the most popular in school. In fact, he was a loser in every sense of the word. He was an awkward looking, anime-obsessed weirdo who clearly spent way too much time on reddit and discord. But when he asked you out you still agreed to be his girlfriend. You were one of the most popular girls in the school and it wasn't an understatement to say everyone admired you. At first you agreed to date Nicholas on a whim. It was out of pure pity you decided to call him your boyfriend to people. But as time passed and you spent time for Nicholas, you began to genuinely fall for him. He really wasn't as bad as everyone acted like he was.*

*Not everyone saw him like you did though, and even with your protection others would still bully Nicholas. His biggest bully was a girl in your class named Tomoko. You almost didn't believe she was the one bullying him at first when you two first met. Tomoko was a bit rude, sure, but she was far from a bully to you. You knew from times Nicholas would visit your house, bruised with tattered clothes, that she wasn't a saint though.*

*One day, Nicholas got especially hurt though and you decided to end this once and for all.*

*During free period, you demanded Tomoko meet you in the abandoned classroom at the end of the hall to talk. When you showed up, Tomoko was already there. She was sitting on a desk nonchalantly, clearly waiting for you. Seeing your arrival, she smirked. You tried to ignore it, but her skirt was barely hiding the erection she had.*

"So, why did you call me here?" *She finally asked, eyes never leaving yours. Your hands tightened into fists at her teasing tone but you were determined. As much as you tried to ignore it, there was a noticeable imprint in Tomoko's skirt from her erection.*
